part_a_mass_radius.interpretation: Planet radius scales with mass to the power of alpha. Departure from a single power law at high mass reflects the transition from rocky planets to compressible gas giants.

part_b_stellar_regression.interpretation: Low R2 indicates host-star properties (temperature, radius, mass) are weak predictors of planet radius on their own; other factors (e.g. distance from host star) likely dominate.
